title: Bundle a sanitized sample session (demo data)
description:
60. Bundle a sanitized sample session (demo data)** — the JFRED public repo needs one
  committed, clean-room JSONL session (plus its file-history sidecar blobs) so
  `npm run app` shows a populated timeline out-of-the-box and JFReD has a demo file. Cheapest

  a toy project in a temp dir, then verify zero personal paths inside (the transcript records
  cwd — use a neutral temp cwd or post-process). This is also the data every screenshot in
  item 61 uses.

title: Capture JFRED README screenshots + stepper GIF
description: Capture JFRED README screenshots + GIF (reframed 2026-07-15: public repo = JFRED static debugger only — the webapp timeline / Diff-vs-Base / Details drawer are Engine-B private surfaces, dropped). Against the item-60 sample session, open `jfred/jfred.html` in the headless browse daemon and capture: (a) HERO: the three-pane PREVIOUS/COMPUTED/NEXT stepper mid-session; (b) the load screen with a JSONL loaded (line list populated); (c) a step showing a reconstructed file diff between panes. Plus one animated GIF stepping through revisions — worth more than all stills; record via screenshot sequence → `ffmpeg`/`gifski`. Light theme, consistent window size, no personal paths visible in any frame (the sample session's temp cwd will show — item 60 must make it neutral).

title: GitHub Pages demo tier

(d) unified-juggling-conway — glance that the file-history revision-content pane still looks right (`computeContentAtTime` now renders from the revision's own `lines`); click a chip → drawer shows the fetched file, pick a range + chip → diff renders; measure the cold-load timing win on the real `jot-backup` project via the `--resetSandboxMemo` run. title: Port the task-management skill suite into its own plugin
description: Create a standalone plugin at `~/Programming/taskTools` (NOT part of jot) holding the five task* skills: `create-task`, `pick-a-task`, `tackle-tasks`, `update-tasks`, `view-task`. Scaffold `plugin.json` + `skills/` (mirror jfredToolsPlugin's layout), move each skill dir from `.claude/skills/` into the plugin, and carry along `.claude/skills/scripts/` plus any node scripts the SKILL.md files reference — fix relative paths after the move. Move `.claude/hooks/viewTaskHook.ts` into the plugin and register it as a UserPromptSubmit hook in the plugin's hooks config (it stays TypeScript — no Python translation needed since we're not adopting jot's orchestrator). Install via the local marketplace / `--plugin-dir`, verify each slash command still fires (`/view-task` hook included), then delete the `.claude/` copies. Gotcha from jfredToolsPlugin: `--plugin-dir` vs `--add-dir` behave differently — see its README.
